ui.preferencesHint: Interface language changes text; date and number format changes displayed values. Enter dates and amounts in the required input format.
ui.preferencesNotSaved: Preferences work for this session but could not be saved in this browser.
ui.loginInstructions: Sign in with your organization's identity provider.
ui.historyHint: History entries are read-only. Expand an entry to see the recorded case details and who recorded them.
ui.lifecycleUnavailable: Lifecycle status is unavailable for this case.
ui.lifecycleSuppressionRetained: Live payload erased; suppression evidence retained
ui.lifecycleErasureFinal: Managed payload erasure complete; suppression evidence retained
ui.lifecycleHeld: HELD: active holds block payload erasure.
ui.lifecycleVoidApproval: Voiding this case requires two distinct approvals and does not reverse a payment.
ui.unchangedUntilSubmit: Review your changes before recording them.
ui.dateHint: Use ASCII digits in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-06.
ui.amountHint: Use ASCII digits and a dot, for example 125.50; up to {maximum} decimal places. No signs or commas.
ui.noAuthoredValues: This action needs no additional details.
ui.correctionHint: Choose an action for each group. Kept details use the current case when recorded.
ui.changeCommandDescription: Changing the action discards these draft details and starts a different request.
ui.reviewDescription: Check and confirm the details. If recording is unconfirmed, inspect Recovery before trying again.
ui.keepForRecovery: Back to editing; keep for Recovery
ui.capacity: Pending recovery storage: {count} / {maximum} requests · {bytes} / {maximumBytes} bytes of exact request content.
ui.nearCapacity: Near capacity; resolve or dismiss known pending items.
ui.recoveryHint: Pending requests appear by default. Terminal view shows accepted, dismissed and revoked authority as non-executable evidence. Inspect server state before recording or dismissing a request.
ui.attemptCount: {count, plural, one {# attempt shown.} other {# attempts shown.}}
ui.revokedHint: This revoked authority is terminal. It cannot be resurrected or submitted.
ui.dismissPreparation: Stop future recording of this request
ui.recoveryDetailsHint: Request authority and attempt evidence from the server. Request details preserve the exact entered values.
ui.resolveTitle: Try to record the reviewed request?
ui.dismissTitle: Permanently end this request’s future authority?
ui.exportWarning: This file contains claimant data and recovery bytes. Save it only in private storage.
ui.importDescription: Retained only after confirmation, for explicit Recovery action; never submitted automatically.
ui.resolveConsequence: The server may record this exact request if still permitted, or show an earlier accepted result. The returned outcome tells you what happened; success is not guaranteed.
ui.dismissConsequence: Confirmed dismissal permanently prevents future execution of this unaccepted request. It cannot be undone and does not settle earlier uncertain attempts. Check the returned outcome to confirm dismissal.
ui.canonicalCopyHint: Copies the exact underlying value. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and amounts use a decimal point, regardless of display format.
ui.leaveDraftDescription: Leaving discards draft edits. Retained requests stay in Recovery; leaving does not stop them or settle earlier attempts.
